topics.title: "1 1/2 object" or "1 1/2 objects"?
topics.text:
Today, I've read some problems, and I was mostly triggered because of their poorly written grammar.



But there was this one thing which bothers me the most. It is about when adding an "s" to a noun or not, depending on its quantity.



Let's say you have an object whose length is $n$ km. For which values of $n$ is it correct to say "$n\text{ kilometers}$", and for which $n$ is it correct to say "$n\text{ kilometer}$"?



Most people know that if $n$ is a nonnegative integer, then just add an "s" at the end, except for when $n=1$, which in that case, do not add an "s" at the end. Another is that if $n$ is a positive rational number less than $1$, then do not add an "s" at the end as well.



But how about for other values of $n$? For example: Which one is correct to say? $1\tfrac12\text{ kilometer}$ or $1\tfrac12\text{ kilometers}$?

How about between $\tfrac32\text{ kilometer}$ or $\tfrac32\text{ kilometers}$?





It does not stop there. Which one is correct?



$\sqrt2\text{ kilometer}$ or $\sqrt2\text{ kilometers}$?

$\tfrac1\pi\text{ kilometer}$ or $\tfrac1\pi\text{ kilometers}$?

$(3^2-2^3)\text{ kilometer}$ or $(3^2-2^3)\text{ kilometers}$?



(Of course, you might say the correct answer to this last one is actually $1\text{ kilometer}$. But suppose that you didn't know what it simplified to.)





Even worse, the number of objects is not necessarily always positive. It can be negative, and maybe even imaginary.



Which one is correct?



$-1\text{ kilometer}$ or $-1\text{ kilometers}$?

$\sqrt{-1}\text{ kilometer}$ or $\sqrt{-1}\text{ kilometers}$?



When is it correct to add an "s" to a noun, depending on its quantity?

topics.title: Star Mathlete Contest
topics.text:
Hey Everyone!



I am starting a contest, which I am calling, the Star Mathlete Contest!



This is how things will happen.



#1) I will attempt to get 5 other problem writers besides me. If you want to be a problem writer, you must have a gmail account for Google Docs.



Add your name to the signups list.



Problem Writer Signups (1/6)1. Flame2005




#2) I will attempt to get at least 25 Contestants.



Contestant Signups (0)




#3) The problem writers will PM their gmail accounts to me and together we will write a series of 30 problems, ranging from easy to hard, computation to proof.



#4) Once we are done, each contestant will be assigned a problem writer (PW). Each problem writer will PM contestants assigned to them the file.



#5) Contestants will have one week to complete this first round. Once finished, they will PM their assigned PW. Solutions PMed to me or anyone besides said PW will not be counted, and the contestant will be disqualified.



#6) PWs will score these solutions with 1 point being given for a correct answer to a problem, and 0 points given to incorrect proofs/answers. The top 20 shall move on to the next round.



#7) Contestants from this next round shall be assigned to the same PW, and the PWs together will write 20 more problems, which are harder, and the contestants have 6 days to complete these problems.



#8) All else shall be the same as the first round.



#9) Top 10 in these shall move on to the next round, which will be the same, but with 10 problems, which are (again) harder, and contestants have 5 days.



#10) All else shall be the same as the first round.



#11) Top 5 shall move on to the final round, which will be the same, with 5 extremely hard problems, and the contestants have 4 days.



#12) The top 3 shall be crowned.



You have one week to sign up, problem writers. Contestants, you have as long as you want until I say that signups are over.



Good Luck.

topics.title: Calculator Problem
topics.text:
Last night I was messing around on my TI 84 plus CE. I was on one of the data sheet apps. I think I hit copy and menu at the same time or one after another, and it wouldn’t load. I let it sit trying for 10 minutes but that little circle kept spinning. I ended up unscrewing the back and popping out the battery, but when I put it back in the calculator the RAM was reset. Thankfully I didn’t have anything saved on it, but I would like to know how to prevent this.

Has this ever happened to anyone else?

What should I do if this ever happens again?
